title: Europoor 3x $105 MRNA Jan 15th 27 calls -> 14k gain
selftext:
I read someone’s MRNA DD here a while ago while it was on a downtrend. I thought about buying them but was cash strapped. A few months later I read some article about their cancer vaccine product and checked the ticker, it had bottomed and went up a little. The news seemed to confirm the DD. So I went back and it said something about some catalysts in 2026/2027.

I had just received my bonus and thought well the stock is still down a bit and could go up just by itself, if a catalyst hits I could make some money. Since, bonus or not I’m still a europoor I bought OTM calls with enough time to expiration and landed on the Jan 15, 2027 $105 options. I bought 4 for $290 each. In July I sold one call for $1,147 to roughly get my initial investment back.

Today I put in some trailing limit sell orders that netted me another 14k in profits!

Me and the tax man are happy. Do not follow me, it wouldn’t help you anyway because my brain works in mysterious ways.
